head: codex/4646-v0917-external-review
title: [v0.91.7][WP-19] Restore truthful external-review preparation state
body:
Refs #4646

Corrects the prematurely merged WP-19 completion claims. The original #5573 closeout audit remains complete; #5571 and #5573 are closed; PR #5579 is retained as a superseded historical target; and WP-19 remains open while a current 70-file replacement corpus awaits external review. This PR does not run or claim the replacement external review and does not close #4646.
